_note: QA reason codes. fix: repair (one-change edit), finish (free post-process), regenerate. Rejection notes from the user become new codes or prompt rules.

drawcord_shape.instruction: the two drawcords: make them flat woven drawcords about 1 cm wide in the garment colour, equal length, hanging straight, ending in short metal aglets and passing through the metal eyelets

drawcord_count.instruction: the drawcords: exactly two drawcords of equal length, one through each metal eyelet, each ending in a short metal aglet

rib_width.instruction: the cuffs and hem: even 2x2 rib of consistent width, clearly distinct from the body fleece

shoulder_seam.instruction: the shoulder seams: {shoulder} shoulder seams matching the fit

pocket_shape.instruction: the kangaroo pocket: symmetrical openings on both sides, the pocket attached at the hem

hood_shape.instruction: the hood: a double-layer hood with a centre seam that holds its shape

zip.instruction: the zip: one continuous metal zip with even teeth and a single pull, running from hem to neck

hands.instruction: the hands: natural hands with five fingers each, clearly separate from the pocket

unintended_text.instruction: remove all text, letters and logos from the garment and background, leaving plain fabric

logo_text.instruction: the logo at the {placement}: reproduce the artwork in Image 2 exactly, with the text "{text}" spelled exactly, same size and position, same {technique} finish

logo_shape.instruction: the logo at the {placement}: reproduce the shapes and proportions of the artwork in Image 2 exactly, same size and position, same {technique} finish

logo_colour.instruction: the logo at the {placement}: use exactly the colours of the artwork in Image 2, same size, position and {technique} finish

logo_size.instruction: the size of the logo at the {placement}: scale it to about {size_cm} cm wide, which is about {torso_share}% of the chest width, keeping its design, position and {technique} finish
